content: Play Health apps: mandatory Health apps declaration form; Jan 2026 enforcement adds medical-device labeling (non-certified apps must put 'not a medical device...' disclaimer in FIRST paragraph of store description), org-account requirement (individual dev accounts cannot host health apps after 2026-01-28, D-U-N-S needed), privacy policy URL must be identical across Play Console/in-app/website and a public web page (no PDFs). Common rejections: 'Inaccurate Health Apps Declaration' loops, 'Excessive data access for declared feature' (each Health Connect data type must be essential to primary function; incidental-access banned), requesting undeclared HC data types, adding a clinical feature without re-submitting the declaration.
